annotation.title_clean: AI Utilization Guidelines: Practical Reference for AI utilization
annotation.title_en: AI Utilization Guidelines: Practical Reference for AI utilization
annotation.authors_or_issuer: The Conference toward AI Network Society (Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications, Japan)
annotation.venue: Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications (soumu.go.jp)
annotation.summary_en: Japan's voluntary soft-law AI Utilization Guidelines (2019) set out ten AI Utilization Principles with commentary for AI service providers, business users, data providers and consumers. They aim to operationalise the Social Principles of Human-Centric AI and the OECD Recommendation. Robots are mentioned only as examples of AI systems.
key_provisions_or_claims: Ten principles: proper utilization, data, collaboration, safety, security, privacy, dignity and autonomy, fairness, transparency, accountability
Non-binding soft law; stakeholders are expected to act voluntarily
Defines AI software and AI systems (e.g., robots, cloud systems); scope covers networkable AI
Roles differentiated among developers, AI service providers, business users, consumer users, data providers
Aligned with OECD Recommendation on AI and G20 AI Principles
